objective: Review the definition-only execution boundary after accepted direct command-path sidecar stage-plan materialization metadata, decide whether a later run gate may execute a narrow reviewed sidecar build/run/compare sequence, and keep this review from claiming direct Verilator command execution, sidecar stage execution by this gate, RTL simulation, compare execution, measured timing, speedup, arbitrary filelist support, automatic GPU allocation, runtime/ABI change, raw full-state equality, or native Verilator option support.

review_decision.reason: The definition is narrow enough for a later run gate because it admits only ready direct materialization metadata from the reviewed fixture, requires all non-execution flags to be false before any command can run, requires the reviewed seven-stage sidecar order, keeps preserved parser files and filelists as parser inputs rather than source-closure authority, validates state_count and step_count through parser_schedule_constraints instead of assuming them as direct stage_plan fields, and keeps coverage_output_equivalence as a future compare result rather than evidence from this review.
review_decision.weakest_point: The accepted materialization metadata can look close to executable because it contains a ready sidecar stage plan reached from direct parser inputs. The accepted boundary therefore permits only a later scoped sidecar build/run/compare run derived from reviewed ready metadata and the reviewed stage order; it still does not permit direct Verilator command execution, arbitrary filelist dependency inference, automatic GPU allocation, measured timing, speedup, runtime/ABI change, raw full-state equality, or broad native option support claims.
accepted_because: the source definition gate is downstream of the accepted metadata-only materialization fixture review
the eligible input surface is ready direct command-path stage-plan materialization metadata only
all execution, measurement, timing, runtime/ABI, source-closure, filelist-expansion, and automatic-allocation flags remain false before a later run
stage_plan shape is accepted from stage_plan metadata while state_count and step_count are validated from parser_schedule_constraints
the required future stage order is explicit and matches the reviewed sidecar build/run/compare sequence
generated evidence remains constrained to reports/ and artifacts/ and is not source of truth
coverage_output_equivalence is preserved as a later compare policy rather than a claim from this review gate
